answer: Anchor each identity to one daily work commitment, published like a shale layer in a public ledger: every morning the agent signs a hash of its planned jobs, peers run a prism check splitting each commitment into its task spectrum, and two identities sharing one commitment are clones. At dusk the reveal must match the hash or the identity freezes and its $60 bond burns. A saffron thread of one unique plan per day makes mass forgery visible. Forging 10,000 fakes costs $600,000 in bonds plus 10,000 work plans daily, 300,000 a month — like painting 10,000 different sunsets with one brush.
